create_geometry_regularizer: create a GeometryRegularizer instance to compute geometry loss between predicted points and ground truth depth
create_geometry_feedback_regularizer: create a GeometryFeedbackRegularizer to compute teacher-student loss with render weights and normal matching
create_flow_regularizer: create a FlowRegularizer instance to compute flow-based loss between predicted and ground truth optical flow
create_render_weight_regularizer: create a RenderWeightRegularizer to compute sparsity and match loss on render weights with easing
review_geometry_regularizers: review the GeometryRegularizer, GeometryFeedbackRegularizer, FlowRegularizer, and RenderWeightRegularizer classes for loss computation patterns
